text:
Which statement about the manufacture of ammonia is correct?
Ammonia is manufactured by heating hydrogen and nitrogen at 50°C and 1.0atm.
A
B
Ammonia is obtained by heating hydrogen and nitrogen in the Contact process.
C
Hydrogen for the manufacture of ammonia is extracted from air.
D
The reaction between hydrogen and nitrogen to form ammonia is reversible.

options.label: A
options.text: Ammonia is manufactured by heating hydrogen and nitrogen at 50°C and 1.0atm.

options.label: B
options.text: Ammonia is obtained by heating hydrogen and nitrogen in the Contact process.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrogen for the manufacture of ammonia is extracted from air.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction between hydrogen and nitrogen to form ammonia is reversible.
